WAIT_TIME = 3                # Seconds between actions

    options = Options()
    options.set_preference("browser.download.folderList", 2)
    options.set_preference("browser.download.dir", DOWNLOAD_DIR)

    time.sleep(WAIT_TIME)

    search_box = driver.find_element(By.NAME, "q")
    search_box.send_keys(query)
    search_box.send_keys(Keys.RETURN)
    time.sleep(WAIT_TIME)

    for page in range(RESULT_PAGES):
        results = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "article")

        for r in results:

                link = r.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, "a").get_attribute("href")
                snippet = r.text

                        driver.switch_to.window(driver.window_handles[-1])

    return data


def save_to_excel(data):

    print(f"\nSaved {len(df)} records to {OUTPUT_FILE}")

import time

import os
import socket

import speech_recognition as sr
import pyttsx3

from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.firefox.options import Options

from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer


# =========================
# BASIC SETTINGS
# =========================

EXCEL_FILE = "scraped_data.xlsx"
DOWNLOAD_DIR = os.path.abspath("downloads")

MAX_PAGES = 2
MAX_RESULTS = 8
MIN_DELAY = 2
MAX_DELAY = 5

RELATED_SHIFT_PROBABILITY = 0.4


# =========================
# VOICE ENGINE
# =========================

engine = pyttsx3.init()
engine.setProperty("rate", 160)

def speak(text):
    print("AI:", text)
    engine.say(text)
    engine.runAndWait()


# =========================
# SPEECH INPUT
# =========================

def listen():
    r = sr.Recognizer()
    with sr.Microphone() as source:
        r.adjust_for_ambient_noise(source, duration=0.5)
        audio = r.listen(source)

    try:
        text = r.recognize_google(audio)
        print("YOU:", text)
        return text
    except:
        return None


# =========================
# INTERNET CHECK
# =========================

def internet_available():
    try:
        socket.create_connection(("8.8.8.8", 53), timeout=2)

    print("Tiny semantic model loaded.")

    print("Tiny model unavailable. Using fallback.")


# =========================
# SEMANTIC UNDERSTANDING
# =========================

INTENTS = [
    "search information",
    "find data",
    "research topic",
    "learn about something",
    "explore related topic",
    "exit"
]

def semantic_intent_and_topic(text):
    if not TINY_MODEL:
        return "search information", text

    embeddings = TINY_MODEL.encode(INTENTS + [text])
    scores = np.dot(embeddings[-1], np.array(embeddings[:-1]).T)
    intent = INTENTS[int(scores.argmax())]

    words = [w for w in text.split() if len(w) > 3]
    topic = " ".join(words[:10]) if words else text

    return intent, topic


def related_topic_shift(topic):
    if not TINY_MODEL:
        return topic

    modifiers = [
        "future of",
        "challenges in",
        "applications of",
        "benefits of",
        "risks of",
        "comparison with",
        "impact on society"
    ]

    if random.random() < RELATED_SHIFT_PROBABILITY:
        return f"{random.choice(modifiers)} {topic}"

    return topic


# =========================
# FIREFOX SETUP
# =========================

def setup_firefox():
    options = Options()
    options.set_preference("browser.download.folderList", 2)
    options.set_preference("browser.download.dir", DOWNLOAD_DIR)
    options.set_preference(
        "browser.helperApps.neverAsk.saveToDisk",
        "application/pdf,image/jpeg,image/png"
    )
    options.set_preference("pdfjs.disabled", True)

    driver = webdriver.Firefox(options=options)
    driver.maximize_window()
    return driver


def random_sleep():
    time.sleep(random.uniform(MIN_DELAY, MAX_DELAY))


# =========================
# SEARCH & SCRAPE
# =========================

def search_and_scrape(query):
    driver = setup_firefox()
    collected = []

    driver.get("https://duckduckgo.com/")

    box.send_keys(query)

                title = r.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, "h2").text

                snippet = r.text

                    "Title": title,
                    "URL": link,
                    "Snippet": snippet

            except:

                driver.find_element(By.LINK_TEXT, "Next").click()
                random_sleep()
        except:

    driver.quit()

    random.shuffle(collected)
    return collected[:random.randint(3, MAX_RESULTS)]


# =========================
# SAVE TO EXCEL (MEMORY)
# =========================

def save_to_excel(rows):
    df_new = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if os.path.exists(EXCEL_FILE):
        df_old = pd.read_excel(EXCEL_FILE)
        df = pd.concat([df_old, df_new]).drop_duplicates()
    else:
        df = df_new

    df.to_excel(EXCEL_FILE, index=False)


# =========================

# =========================

    os.makedirs(DOWNLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)

        if not user_text:

        save_to_excel(results)

        speak(f"I found {len(results)} new insights.")

        last_topic = topic


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
